ACID='PA1544695' (WILL BE UPDATED) .
ACID='PA1534366' (WILL BE DELETED) . 
ACID='PA1534963' (UNCHANGED) .
ACID='9999' (NEW RECORD) . 

select ACID ACID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_CUSTGENCUSTACMASTER WHERE ACID='PA1544695'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_CUSTGENCUSTACMASTER WHERE ACID='PA1534366'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_CUSTGENCUSTACMASTER WHERE ACID='PA1534963'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_CUSTGENCUSTACMASTER WHERE ACID='9999' ) temp order by ACID, SCD_START_DATE
